# One case per line: name|standard input|arguments of the language command.
# Arguments split on spaces. An empty standard input field means no input.
text-stdin-offender|Nous corrigeons le code avec le fichier|text --label proposal -
text-stdin-clean|The proposal is written in English.|text -
text-stdin-default|Nous corrigeons le code avec le fichier|text
text-file-offender||text docs/francais.md
text-file-clean||text README.md docs/clean.md
text-file-missing||text docs/absent.md
files-all||files
files-pathspec||files -- README.md docs/clean.md
files-diff||files --diff HEAD~1..HEAD
files-diff-invalid||files --diff nosuch..HEAD
files-diff-missing-range||files --diff
commits-offender||commits HEAD~1..HEAD
commits-clean||commits HEAD~1
commits-invalid||commits nosuch..HEAD
commits-missing-range||commits
tasks-invalid-limit||tasks --limit 0
tasks-extra-argument||tasks extra
unknown-mode||bogus
